summary.headline: Julian’s Astronomical Investigations
summary.text: Catalog entries for a Modena manuscript covering epochs, centers, lots, winds, twelfth-parts, astrological places, solar and lunar epochs, eclipses, planetary calculations and risings, zodiacal degrees, the four elements, and mathematical sciences. It includes astronomical investigations by Julian of Laodicea, a work attributed to Heraclitus, a Christian short work, and a figure of the circle of lands.
